comment: MCP servers installed by my-skills. install.sh / install.ps1 read this file and run `claude mcp add --scope user <name> <command> -- <args>` for each entry. `requires` declares an external runtime prerequisite; entries whose requirement is not met are skipped with a clear notice (not silently).

servers.name: playwright

servers.description: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation for any library/framework (Upstash Context7).

servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning tool (MCP reference server).

servers.name: firebase
servers.description: Work with Firebase projects from the agent: Firestore/Storage rules, Auth, FCM, Crashlytics, Remote Config, App Hosting, SQL Connect, Functions logs.

servers.name: dart
